integrity: Standalone universal proof and a standard-library computational checker are embedded in the same package; no independent external validation asserted.
primary_msc_reason: Exact VC and Littlestone ranks of a natural family of finite two-sorted binary incidence structures, understood as dependence and order-type complexity.
scientific_limitations: Only edge-incidence concepts of all antipodal shortest paths in the unweighted Boolean cube are analyzed. Arbitrary graph geodesics, general endpoint pairs and vertex queries are outside scope. Exhaustive global priority and independent audit are not claimed.
title: Sharp static and adaptive edge shattering of antipodal cube geodesics
